title: Panels System Fix - Component Reuse Invariant Violation
objectives: Fix Component Reuse invariant violation in V9PanelShell by replacing inline styles with existing CSS classes from wanderlustTokens.css
Replace inline style objects with class names that leverage predefined .wl-panel styles
Maintain all existing functionality while using CSS classes instead of inline styles
invariants: Component Reuse: Before writing new UI component markup/styling, verify if equivalent primitive exists. V9PanelShell currently uses inline styles instead of existing .wl-panel classes from wanderlustTokens.css
Skin/Theme: All styles must pass through wanderlustTokens.css, which already defines .wl-panel, .wl-panel::before, .wl-panel::after classes with proper styling
Config-first: No hardcoded values - use existing CSS classes that reference tokens

operations.description: Remove all inline style objects from V9PanelShell.tsx (panelStyle, headerStyle, titleStyle, dragHandleStyle, activeState)
Apply .wl-panel class to the main panel container div instead of inline panelStyle
Apply .wl-panel-corner class for corner decoration if needed (remove from inline styles)
For header, use CSS classes with wanderlustTokens tokens instead of inline headerStyle (e.g., background: var(--raised), border-bottom: 1px solid var(--panel-border))
For drag handle, use CSS classes with wanderlustTokens tokens instead of inline dragHandleStyle (e.g., color: var(--t2), cursor: move)
For active state, use CSS class .active with border-color: var(--acc-primary) and box-shadow: var(--shadow-gold) instead of inline activeState
Verify that the component still renders correctly with CSS classes instead of inline styles

guardrails: DO NOT create new CSS file - use existing wanderlustTokens.css classes
DO NOT add new CSS variables - all needed variables already exist in wanderlustTokens.css
DO NOT duplicate primitive markup - reuse existing .wl-panel classes
Maintain all existing props and functionality of V9PanelShell
Ensure drag functionality still works after style changes
acceptance_criteria: V9PanelShell uses CSS classes instead of inline styles for all visual styling
Component uses .wl-panel class from wanderlustTokens.css for main panel container
Component uses wanderlustTokens CSS variables via CSS classes, not inline styles
All existing functionality (drag, close, active state) still works
Visual appearance matches or improves compared to inline style version
No new CSS files or variables created
Component Reuse invariant is satisfied - reusing existing CSS classes
notes: The wanderlustTokens.css file already defines comprehensive panel styling with .wl-panel class including ::before and ::after pseudo-elements for rim light and noise overlay. V9PanelShell should leverage these existing classes instead of duplicating styling logic with inline styles.
